domainhints: WI HIX On-Exchange inbound 834 from CMS. Trading partner for this story is CMS, carrying Wisconsin (WI) On-Exchange members - this is a NEW member population CareSource does not currently receive. AC1: a file from CMS containing WI members is dropped at the Edifecs NAS location and must be processed with its data loaded into EDIStageArchive. AC2: the same file must also produce a canonical on the TM. AC3: a 999 functional acknowledgment must be returned to CMS for every inbound file (do not test State-specific 999 handling - out of scope). AC4 (SNIP validation): this condition is scoped to a DIFFERENT source/population than AC1-AC3 - a file from HealthSherpa for an Off-Exchange member is dropped at the EDI NAS location and must be rejected at SNIP levels 1 and 2; of that rejected set, only the SNIP-2-rejected transaction is expected to still load into EDIStageArchive (the SNIP-1 rejection does not load). Do not conflate the CMS/WI/On-Exchange population (AC1-AC3) with the HealthSherpa/Off-Exchange population (AC4) - keep them as separate scenarios. No loop/segment/element mappings, date fields, plan codes, or crosswalk tables were supplied in the work item, so do not invent DTP/loop references, plan codes, or SQL crosswalk validations beyond EDIStageArchive and the TM canonical check - validate only what AC1-AC4 literally state. Per story comments, this feature may already be superseded in Production by User Story 363835 (834 > HealthSherpa > canonical > IBM queue) - scenarios must strictly test AC1-AC4 as written and must not assume this story is still an open gap.
